entries.title: CBD
entries.mainText:
With a grip stifling and tight
you take me to a new height;
With a whisper stern and sweet
and a beauty too concrete
you entice my soul
to give it gaping black hole;

What a hold you have on me
I'd stay though my soul screams 'flee'
Consume my all, my all for thee

entries.title: Delusions
entries.mainText:
Behind the screen 
I feel them glean
Silently stripping me 
Of my precious dignity 
I swear my ears heard 
Shutters as fast as this bird 
No, I know it's absurd 
But I swear my ears heard 
Of my precious dignity 
Silently stripped off me 
As they insidiously glean 
From behind the screen

entries.title: Projector
entries.mainText:
Through what lens do we see
The world that seems gloomy
Or is it angry?
Depends on what hounds me
What is, is my mind
I can see what I want to find
Does it make me blind?
No, that really is mankind.

entries.title: The Killing of Thoughts
entries.mainText:
In not too long a distance, I see
A swift descent designed so steeply
Everyone around's up and about
Indifferent of their frothing mouth;
Life, feigned ignorance, hypnotic daze
We're all dancing in the same dark place
As the killer crawls under the skin
Spreading disease in the mind, unseen
Divided, conquered, masterfully
At once, death falls upon the witty

entries.title: Going Home
entries.mainText:
I love this place.
I was here last time.
Tomorrow again.
The day after that, we'll see.
But it's life on repeat
entries.imageAlt: A photo of buildings from train station platform

entries.title: Beauty of Life
entries.mainText:
Tell me what flower this is,
if only to save me from asking a lifeless box

entries.title: Dancing Water
entries.mainText:
Like a kid, I marvel at fountains.
Give me back the bliss of not knowing.
It's all just magic
entries.imageAlt: An image of a fountain with colorful lights
